name: Comic Book: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Comic Book look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, American comic book art, bold black ink outlines with heavy spot blacks, dynamic foreshortening, halftone dot shading, flat four-colour palette, strong complementary colours, dramatic single light source
negative_prompt: photorealistic, soft painterly shading, anime, 3d render, blurry, extra limbs, speech bubbles, watermark
